create.title: Create organization
create.description: Create a new organization to manage your team and projects.
create.info: Your organization name should be unique and descriptive.

join.title: Join organization
join.description: Join an organization to collaborate with your team, manage projects efficiently, and access shared resources.

header.title: Organization settings
header.description: Manage your organization settings and preferences.

disclaimer.title: You have been invited to join an organization
disclaimer.description: Sign in or create an account to accept the invitation and join the organization.

expired.title: Invitation not found or expired
expired.description: The invitation you are looking for is either expired or does not exist. Please contact the organization owner to renew the invite.

emailMismatch.title: You're currently logged in with a different account
emailMismatch.description: The email you are trying to use does not match the invitation email. Please sign in as <bold>{{email}}</bold> or contact the organization owner to update the invitation.

emailUnverified.title: Verify your email to join
emailUnverified.description: You need to verify <bold>{{email}}</bold> before you can view and accept this invitation. We'll send you a link that brings you back here.

invitation.title: Join {{organizationName}}
invitation.description: <bold>{{inviterEmail}}</bold> has invited you to join <bold>{{organizationName}}</bold> on Lemru.

banner.description: Click to review the details and accept or reject the invitation.

list.title: Pending invitations
list.description: View and manage your pending invitations.

header.title: Organization members
header.description: Manage your organization members, invitations and roles.

invite.title: Invite member
invite.description: To add a new member to your organization, send them an invitation.
invite.info: You can invite multiple members at once.
invite.missingPermission: You need additional permissions to invite members to this organization.

email.subject: You have been invited to join an organization
email.body: <bold>{{inviter}}</bold> has invited you to join <bold>{{organization}}</bold> on Lemru.
email.or: Or, copy and paste this link into your browser:
email.disclaimer: If you were not expecting this invitation, there's nothing to worry about, you can safely ignore this email.

role.title: Update {{name}}'s role
role.description: Change the role of the selected member by selecting it from the dropdown menu.
role.info: The role determines the permissions of the member.

edit.description: Please enter your organization name, or a display name you are comfortable with.
edit.missingPermission: You need additional permissions to manage your organization's name.

logo.description:
This is your organization logo.
Click on the logo to upload a custom one from your files.
logo.info: While not required, adding a logo is highly recommended.
logo.missingPermission: You need additional permissions to manage your organization's logo.

leave.title: Leave organization
leave.description: Revoke your access to this organization. Any resources you've added to the organization will remain.
leave.disclaimer:
Are you sure you want to leave this organization?

You will no longer have access to its resources and will need to be invited again to join.

Do you want to continue?
leave.success: You have left the organization successfully!
leave.cannotLeaveAsOnlyOwner: To leave this organization, ensure at least one more member has the Owner role.

delete.title: Delete organization
delete.description: Permanently remove this organization and all of its contents from the Lemru platform. This action is not reversible, so please continue with caution.
delete.disclaimer:
You are about to delete this organization. 

After deleting it, all organization data (including members and teams) will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. 

Do you want to continue?

blocker.missingPermission: You need additional permissions to delete this organization.

subscriptions.description_one: This organization has 1 active subscription. Please cancel all subscriptions before deleting.
subscriptions.description_other: This organization has {{count}} active subscriptions. Please cancel all subscriptions before deleting.

billing.title: Organization billing
billing.description: Manage your organization's billing settings and subscriptions.

error.cannotCreateNew: You cannot create a new organization.
error.maximumNumberOfOrganizations: You have reached the maximum number of organizations.
error.alreadyExists: An organization with this name already exists.
error.userNotMember: You are not a member of this organization.
error.userAlreadyMember: You are already a member of this organization.
error.cannotLeaveAsOnlyOwner: You cannot leave the organization as the only owner.
error.cannotLeaveWithoutOwner: You cannot leave the organization without an owner.
error.membershipLimitReached: You have reached the membership limit for this organization.

team.cannotCreateNew: You cannot create a new team.
team.alreadyExists: A team with this name already exists.
team.maximumNumberOfTeams: You have reached the maximum number of teams.
team.unableToRemoveLastTeam: You cannot remove the last team.
team.cannotCreate: You cannot create a team in this organization.
team.cannotDelete: You cannot delete a team in this organization.
team.cannotUpdate: You cannot update a team in this organization.
team.cannotAccessMembers: You cannot access the members of this team.
team.memberLimitReached: You have reached the member limit for this team.
team.userNotMember: You are not a member of this team.
team.cannotCreateNewMember: You cannot create a new member.

invitation.cannotInviteUsers: You cannot invite users to this organization.
invitation.userAlreadyInvited: This user is already invited to this organization.
invitation.notRecipient: You are not the recipient of this invitation.
invitation.inviterNoLongerMember: The inviter is no longer a member of the organization.
invitation.cannotInviteUserWithRole: You cannot invite a user with this role.
invitation.emailVerificationRequired: Email verification is required before accepting or rejecting an invitation.
invitation.emailVerificationRequiredForInvitation: Email verification is required to accept this invitation.
invitation.limitReached: You have reached the invitation limit for this organization.

ac.roleAssignedToMembers: The role is assigned to members.
ac.mustBeInOrganizationToCreateRole: You must be in an organization to create a role.
ac.tooManyRoles: You have reached the maximum number of roles.
ac.cannotDeletePreDefinedRole: You cannot delete a pre-defined role.
ac.roleNameAlreadyTaken: The role name is already taken.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Keys call the models through the API and spend this organization's credits. Owners and admins manage them.

search.placeholder: Search by name or paste a key…
search.label: Search keys

create.title: Create an API key
create.description: A key's expiration is set now and cannot be changed later.

error.expiryBeyondMaxLifetime: This expiration is longer than the platform allows. Choose a shorter one.

disable.title: Disable key
disable.description: Are you sure you want to disable {{name}}? You can re-enable it later.

delete.title: Delete key
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.

secret.title: Your new key
secret.description: Please copy it now and write it down somewhere safe. You will not be able to see it again.

name.label: Name
name.description: Choose a clear, descriptive name to identify this key.

expiry.label: Expiration
expiry.readOnly: Expiration cannot be modified. Create a new API key for a new expiration time.
expiry.maximum: The platform allows keys to live at most {{lifetime}}.

limit.label: Credit limit
limit.invalid: Enter an amount above 0, up to 4,000,000.
limit.helper: Requests are rejected once this key has used {{amount}} in total, until you raise its credit limit.
limit.helperReset: Requests are rejected once this key has used {{amount}} in a {{window}}, until it resets or you raise its credit limit.
limit.helperNone: No limit: this key can spend the organization's whole balance.
limit.description: Once the credits consumed by this key reach this amount, the key stops working. Leave blank for no limit.

reset.label: Reset limit every…
reset.description: When the credit limit resets: daily at midnight UTC, weekly on Monday, or monthly on the 1st.

list.empty: No API keys yet. Create your first key to start calling models.

page.notFound: This key does not exist, or it was deleted.
page.usageDescription: Charged requests, in SAR. Weeks start on Monday and every period is in UTC.
page.disableDescription: Prevent this key from being used. You can re-enable it later.
page.enableDescription: Let this key be used again.
page.deleteDescription: Permanently delete this key. This action cannot be undone.
page.expiredNote: This key has expired. Create a new key to keep calling models.

lowBalance.title: Low-balance email
lowBalance.on: Owners and admins are emailed when available credits drop below {{threshold}}, once until credits are added.
lowBalance.invalid: Enter an amount above 0, in riyals and halalas.

email.subject: {{organization}} is running low on credits
email.body: {{organization}} has {{available}} of credits left, below {{threshold}}. When credits run out, requests are refused with 402 until you add more.

topUp.title: Add credits
topUp.description: A one-time card payment. Credits are spent on model requests by every key in this organization.
topUp.feeNote: The fee is added to the payment and is never taken from your credits. Credits are added when the payment is confirmed, usually within seconds.
topUp.invalid: Enter an amount between {{min}} and {{max}}, in riyals and halalas.

success.title: Payment received
success.description: Your credits are added as soon as the payment is confirmed. This page updates by itself.

unavailable.title: Top-ups are temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: Adding credits is paused for now. Your balance and API keys keep working as usual. Please check back later.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: What this organization has to spend on models. Requests in flight hold the most they can cost until they finish.

redeem.title: Redeem a code
redeem.description: Have a code for free credit? Enter it here: the credit is added at once.
redeem.label: Code

lots.title: Your credit by purchase
lots.description: Each top-up, promotion or credit from us, what is left of it and when it expires. Requests spend the credit that expires first.

expiring.title: {{amount}} of credit expires within {{days}} days
expiring.description: The first of it expires on {{date}}. Credit that is left when it expires is removed from your balance.

refund.label: Refund
refund.policy: A top-up's unused credit can be refunded within the refund window shown on its button. The payment processing fee and promotional credit are not refunded. If the top-up came with a promotional bonus, the unused part of the bonus is removed with the refund, in proportion to the credit refunded; bonus already spent is yours to keep.

confirm.title: Refund this top-up?
confirm.description: You get back {{amount}}: the unused part of the {{granted}} of credit this top-up bought. Credit already spent and the payment processing fee are not refunded. The money goes back to the card you paid with, usually within 5 to 10 days.
confirm.bonus: This top-up came with a promotional bonus: {{bonus}} of it, the unused part in proportion to the credit refunded, is removed from your balance too. It is not paid out. Bonus already spent is not taken back.

done.succeeded: {{amount}} refunded. It is on its way back to your card.
done.pending: Refund of {{amount}} requested. The credit stays held until the payment provider confirms it.

dataPolicy.title: Data policy
dataPolicy.description: Decide where this organization's requests may be processed and what a provider may do with them. The policy applies to every API key, and a request that no endpoint can serve under it is refused, never sent elsewhere.
dataPolicy.saved: Data policy saved and applied to every key.
dataPolicy.saveFailed: The policy could not be applied to every key. Save again to retry.
dataPolicy.notApplied: This policy is not on every key yet. Save it again to finish applying it.
dataPolicy.unavailable: The data policy could not be loaded. Try again shortly.
dataPolicy.readOnly: Owners and admins can change the data policy.
dataPolicy.nothingMatches: No endpoint matches these requirements: every request would be refused.

zeroRetention.label: Require zero data retention
zeroRetention.description: Only endpoints that keep no prompts or completions. Endpoints with unknown retention are excluded.

noTraining.label: Never train on our data
noTraining.description: Only endpoints that never train on what you send. Endpoints with unknown terms are excluded.

regions.label: Limit where requests are processed
regions.description: Only endpoints in the regions you choose.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: {{matching}} of {{total}} endpoints match the requirements above.

recent.title: Recent requests
recent.description: Each charged request, newest first, its attempts together. Free requests and failed attempts cost nothing and are not listed. Open one to see its record; the id is the x-bifrost-request-id response header, also readable with GET /api/v1/generation?id=.

record.termsChanged: The endpoint's terms were edited after this request. These are the terms recorded when it was made.
record.title: Request
record.note: Timings, finish reason, streaming and the attempts come from request logs, kept for their retention period. Time to first token is the whole latency for a request that was not streamed. The charge and token counts are kept for good. Prompts and completions are never stored.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: This organization's requests, spend and tokens, by day, model and key. A request is counted once however many providers were tried, free and failed ones included; requests refused before reaching a model are counted apart. Prompts and completions are not stored.
activity.requestLogUnavailable: Request counts, refusals and timings come from the request log, which could not be read just now. Spend and tokens are complete.
activity.requestLogNote: Requests, refusals and timings come from the request log and cover its retention period; spend and tokens come from the ledger and are kept for good.
activity.tokenBreakdownDescription: Charged requests. Reasoning is part of the completion; cached tokens are part of the prompt.
activity.refusalsDescription: Refused before any model was called, so never charged. The reason is the error's metadata.reason (see the API's error contract).
activity.noRefusals: No requests were refused in this period.
activity.performanceDescription: Successful requests, measured on the attempt that answered. Time to first token is the whole latency for a request that was not streamed.
